blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Two-time Olympic weightlifter Elreen Ando is determined to add the Asian Games medal to her collection in the Aichi-Nagoya edition, which formally opens on Saturday. “I’m really excited, and hopefully, I can win another medal at the upcoming Asian Games,” Ando said in Filipino, as she competes in the 61kg category. “I’m really eager to win a medal again and hopefully improve on the medal I won last time.” Ando settled for bronze in the 2023 Hangzhou Games with a total lift of 222 kg. “The preparation has […]...
